scope: Sanitized summary from one owner-authorized QN75Q90TAFXZA TV; not a benchmark dataset
limitations: CVE-2022-26330 is patched on T-NKMAKUC-2743.0; operations run as uid=901(sdk) with context=System and group 1051(system_share) rather than UID 0.

Because /opt/usr/share/systemd/system/ is owned by root:root (0755), systemd ConditionPathExists stop-markers cannot be written without UID 0; systemd-launched pisa-service, adagent-service, canalysis-daemon, and context-aware-service still start at boot even though their package records are disabled.

App-framework daemons disabled in .pkgmgr_parser.db (ghdaemon, ghservice, smartthings-client, samsunghealth-service-tv, adplayer, tvplus, context-aware-agent, content-grab-service) remain stopped across full restart.
No decrypted network-traffic audit of this TV was performed.
Future firmware updates may overwrite /opt/dbspace/.app-context.db or /opt/dbspace/.pkgmgr_parser.db routing flags.
